item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We must prepare for that scale of change now.

2. Our position is clear: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and the global economy will at least double in size within the following decade. We see preparation for that transformation as an urgent priority.

3. We expect superintelligent AI to transform the world’s productive capacity. If it is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its development. We need to think and plan at that scale.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We see this as a transformation of what humanity can produce, discover and deliver—not simply another step in technological progress. We expect breakthroughs in research, engineering and coordination to expand productive capacity across the economy. We must prepare now for the institutions, infrastructure and decisions that such growth will demand. We also know that a larger economy does not automatically mean broadly shared prosperity. Our task is to prepare for extraordinary growth and work to ensure its benefits reach widely.
